claim: candidate mechanism regimes are biologically interpretable
evidence: Step04 has 2098/4107 accepted candidates across 30/37 cells; 26/37 reviewer-facing cells. Step06 unsupported groups all have holdout_pass_fraction=1.0; prediction-limited labels are perturbation/PPC limited, not fit-heldout limited. High-budget probe on 4 VH failure cells upgraded 2 cells to reviewer-facing: 3_VH_1_CONTROL: accepted 0->0, holdout passes 1->0, reviewer-facing False->False; VH_3_MFA: accepted 6->26, holdout passes 2->5, reviewer-facing False->True; VH_4_MFA: accepted 0->3, holdout passes 0->4, reviewer-facing False->True; VH_6_MFA: accepted 2->1, holdout passes 0->0, reviewer-facing False->False.
what_more_optimization_could_change: Can improve reviewer-facing coverage for some VH MFA cells and therefore increase strata/cell evidence available to Steps 05-06; high-budget probe upgraded VH_3_MFA and VH_4_MFA. It did not rescue tested VH CONTROL or VH_6_MFA.
what_it_cannot_solve: Cannot by itself convert model-derived hidden-current clusters into biological pathways; cannot supply external phenotype validation or assumption/parameter gates.
recommended_test: Promote targeted high-budget Step04 reruns for VH MFA and possibly VH CONTROL as a coverage-improvement action, then rerun Steps 05-06 on the upgraded canonical ensemble; do not expect this alone to authorize biological pathway wording.

claim: model assumptions do not drive the conclusion
evidence: Step07 blockers are assumption axes (gating_form; intracellular_K_as_ECS_proxy); these require alternative model forms/ECS/proxy tests under same data, not more iterations of the same Step04 objective.
what_more_optimization_could_change: Could refine same-model candidate parameters used in sensitivity screens.
what_it_cannot_solve: Same-model optimization cannot test gating-family refits, explicit ECS state, omitted-process sensitivity, or spatial grounding.
recommended_test: Implement assumption-specific refit/sensitivity analyses rather than increasing the current Step04 search budget globally.

could_step04_more_optimization_be_strong: unlikely; constrained/refit-prior formulation is the relevant test
evidence: Step08 blocks all 30 best-per-cell candidates from parameter claims; every candidate has out-of-range raw parameters=True; parameter rows include weak identifiability/out-of-range flags. More unconstrained search optimizes Vm fit, not physiological identifiability.
what_more_optimization_could_change: Could find alternative accepted candidates with different raw parameter values if the objective includes constraints or priors.
what_it_cannot_solve: Unconstrained longer Optuna/SciPy cannot prove identifiability and may expand the degenerate/out-of-range manifold.
recommended_test: Run constrained or penalized Step04 refits for selected cells; do not spend on unconstrained global trial count as the first parameter-plausibility fix.

claim: final biological degeneracy wording is allowed
evidence: Final claim is blocked by the conjunction of mechanism distinction, Step06 perturbation/PPC support, Step07 assumptions, Step08 parameters, and homeostasis endpoint gates. Step04 fit coverage is only one upstream prerequisite and is already supported in Step09. High-budget probe on 4 VH failure cells upgraded 2 cells to reviewer-facing: 3_VH_1_CONTROL: accepted 0->0, holdout passes 1->0, reviewer-facing False->False; VH_3_MFA: accepted 6->26, holdout passes 2->5, reviewer-facing False->True; VH_4_MFA: accepted 0->3, holdout passes 0->4, reviewer-facing False->True; VH_6_MFA: accepted 2->1, holdout passes 0->0, reviewer-facing False->False.
what_more_optimization_could_change: May improve coverage and restricted-stratum eligibility, especially VH MFA, but would still need Step06 perturbation/PPC, Step07 assumption, Step08 parameter, and homeostasis endpoint gates.
what_it_cannot_solve: Cannot satisfy assumption robustness, parameter plausibility, perturbation robustness, or external validation/falsification alone.
recommended_test: Use integrated gate matrix to identify whether any restricted stratum is fit-limited before spending on full Step04 reruns.
